name: @atr/tv
description: Across the Room: the far-side check. TV display for Fire TV (React Native for Vega). Standalone project, not a root workspace.

scripts.build:debug: npm run build:packages && react-native build-vega --build-type Debug
scripts.build:release: npm run build:packages && react-native build-vega --build-type Release
scripts.build:packages: npm --prefix ../../packages/protocol run build && npm --prefix ../../packages/session-core run build && npm --prefix ../../packages/ten-foot-meter run build
scripts.bundle:js: react-native bundle --platform kepler --dev false --reset-cache --entry-file index.js --bundle-output build/farsidecheck.bundle
scripts.build:debug:legacy: npm run build:packages && react-native build-kepler --build-type Debug
scripts.build:release:legacy: npm run build:packages && react-native build-kepler --build-type Release
